# mtncloud_key_pairs (Data Source)

Lists your key pairs, including those made in the console. SSH key pairs for instances. Private keys are never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_key_pairs" "all" {}

output "key_pairs" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_key_pairs.all.key_pairs : x.id => { name = x.name, fingerprint = x.fingerprint } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return key pairs whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `key_pairs` (Attributes List) The key pairs, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--key_pairs))

<a id="nestedatt--key_pairs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `key_pairs`

Read-Only:

- `fingerprint` (String) Key fingerprint.
- `has_private_key` (Boolean) Whether MTN Cloud holds the private key.
- `id` (Number) ID of the key pair.
- `name` (String) Name of the key pair.
- `public_key` (String) Public key.
